name: Gyakushuu ~Seiheki no Bigaku~
source:
Main character loses his parents in an accident and lives in his relatives family - uncle, aunt and their three daughters. He remains cold to the family and eventually starts to be treated as a housekeeper. The only joy for him is internet. One day he molests a weak girl in the train. With first crime remaining unpunished, he sets up insult hell for his three new sisters...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在事故中失去父母，寄住在親戚家：叔叔、嬸嬸以及他們的三個女兒。他對這家人始終冷淡，最終甚至被當成傭人對待。他唯一的樂趣是上網。一天，他在電車上猥褻一名軟弱的少女。第一次犯案卻沒受到懲罰後，他為三名新的妹妹設下凌辱地獄……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
